name: Sangai Cafe (Sendra Tourist Home)
signature_dish: Loktak fish curry with rice and iromba
why_it_matters: Effectively the only sit-down restaurant on Loktak Lake itself — the Manipur-Tourism-run cafeteria of Sendra Tourist Home, perched on the hilltop with floor-to-ceiling lake views. The bamboo-fishing-trap ceiling is the one Loktak picture every traveller takes. Fish on the plate is caught from the lake the same morning.
insider_tip: Menu is short and sometimes runs out — ask for the fish-thali first. Closes early; do lunch by 1pm if you've come from Imphal. Pair with the Sendra viewpoint walk above the cafeteria.
signature_address: Sendra Tourist Home, Sendra Island, Loktak Lake, Bishnupur, Manipur 795134
